zin_east_has_capital = {
	exists = yes
	num_of_controlled_states > 0

zin_east_in_region = {
	zin_east_has_capital = yes
	capital_scope = { zin_is_region_east_lands = yes }
}

zin_east_is_power = {
	OR = {
		original_tag = NRS
		original_tag = STA
	}
}

zin_east_is_court = {
	zin_east_in_region = yes
	zin_east_is_power = no
}

zin_east_is_south_court = {
	has_country_flag = zin_east_south_court
}

zin_east_faces_rift = {
	any_owned_state = { zin_is_site_rift_east = yes }
}

# Standard date 1751.3.1, shifted by the story pace.
zin_east_after_caravan_war = {
	OR = {
		AND = { check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace > 1.25 } date > 1752.8.31 }
		AND = { check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace > 0.9 } check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace < 1.25 } date > 1751.3.1 }
		AND = { check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace > 0.5 } check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace < 0.9 } date > 1750.5.31 }
		AND = { check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace < 0.5 } date > 1751.3.1 }
	}
}

zin_east_caravan_war_open = {
	OR = {
		has_global_flag = zin_war_of_last_crowns
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_east_rivalry > 74.99 }
			check_variable = { global.zin_gathering_dark > 24.99 }
			zin_east_after_caravan_war = yes
		}
	}
}

zin_east_claims_open = {
	OR = {
		zin_east_caravan_war_open = yes
		has_global_flag = zin_afrit_king_of_east
	}
}

zin_east_question_open = {
	OR = {
		has_global_flag = zin_afrit_king_of_east
		has_global_flag = zin_eastern_invasion
		AND = {
			has_global_flag = zin_golden_king_dead
			zin_east_after_rift_talk = yes
		}
	}
}

zin_east_rule_refuse = {
	is_ai = yes
	OR = {
		zin_rules_ai_branch_east_refuse_afrit = yes
		AND = {
			zin_rules_ai_random_east = yes
			check_variable = { global.zin_east_rule_roll = 1 }
		}
	}
}

zin_east_rule_unite = {
	is_ai = yes
	OR = {
		zin_rules_ai_branch_east_unite_without_afrit = yes
		AND = {
			zin_rules_ai_random_east = yes
			check_variable = { global.zin_east_rule_roll = 2 }
		}
	}
}

zin_east_free_crown = {
	has_country_flag = zin_afrit_refused_east
	has_global_flag = zin_afrit_king_of_east
	NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_dead }
}

zin_east_at_war_in_the_west = {
	any_enemy_country = {
		zin_east_has_capital = yes
		capital_scope = {
			OR = {
				zin_is_region_magical_lands = yes
				zin_is_region_middle_lands = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
